name_note: Most genomes GTDB places in g__Sellimonas are deposited in NCBI as Sellimonas, and the published literature concerns the species Sellimonas intestinalis rather than the genus as a whole.

sentences.text: Sellimonas intestinalis is a Gram-positive, anaerobic member of the family Lachnospiraceae that was previously considered uncultivable.
It was isolated from faecal samples using a culture protocol for extremely oxygen-sensitive species, and whole genome analysis of eleven genomes found a highly conserved genome.
A microbiome-wide association study reported the genus Sellimonas among taxa associated with depressive symptoms.
A study of patients with ulcerative colitis reported more Sellimonas in those with depression or anxiety than in those without.
